title: Hearty Smoky Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A sour and shaggy weeknight Mediterranean dish featuring roasted peanuts and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, grilled to perfection on a yakimono grill.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb, red onion, and red bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the lamb and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the kebabs are grilling, sprinkle the roasted peanuts over the top.
Once the kebabs are cooked, remove them from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional peanuts and lemon wedges if desired.
